name: San Diego City College Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Take free college classes on the City College campus or online while in high school. You earn college credit. Partner high schools also offer CCAP classes at your school.
who_can_apply: Eligible high school students with guardian and counselor approval. You must meet class prerequisites. The class cannot be one your school offers. PE classes are not allowed.
pay_detail: Tuition is waived if you take less than 12 units a semester.
deadline_text: Registration for high school students starts Dec 1, 2026 for spring 2027. Fall 2026 started May 26, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply to City College to get a student ID. Then send the supplemental form online. It goes to your guardian and counselor to sign. Check your status in the MySDCCD portal.
notes: Keep a 2.0 GPA each semester in your college work. Grades go on your college record for good. Summer 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026. Questions: 619-388-3525.
